title: Phase 0 — static runtime, everything frozen
description: The real viewer mounted offline from a hand-written manifest: card, Plotly figure, MultiSelect and text component, all served from frozen payloads with tier badges. No backend, no network.

title: Phases 1+5 — penguins fully LIVE (cards, filters, figure)
description: Built by producer B from a spec + local Parquet (depictio dashboard build-static). Everything is live: change the species or year selection and the cards recompute AND the scatter re-renders offline — bind-and-refill through the in-browser hyparquet engine. Regenerate with depictio/serverless/examples/generate_demo_manifest.py.
